label: Bible Study
prompt: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the _____.
verse: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
note: The Preacher's famous shrug — 'under the sun' is his signature phrase, and nothing under it is new.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to _____;
verse: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
note: God giveth us richly all things to enjoy — Paul's reminder to trust the Giver, not the riches.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there _____ the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verse: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
note: Babel's builders wanted to make a name; they got one — the place where the language got confounded.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he shall sit as a _____ and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
verse: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
note: The refiner sits watching the silver in the fire; he purifies the priests the same way, patiently.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God _____ reigneth.
verse: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
note: 'Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth' — the words Handel set in the Hallelujah Chorus of Messiah.
